title: Gundam Blitz Order Mobile Game Announced
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment announced the new Gundam Blitz Order "RPG-style idle simulation" mobile game on Thursday. English video Japanese video Bandai Namco Entertainment is currently accepting applications for a network test for the game that will take place from November 18-24.
author: ANN

title: Fate/Extra Record Game Highlights Opponents in New Character Promo Video
content: Aniplex revealed a new "RIVAL's SIDE" character promotional video for Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game, on Thursday.

title: 'Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san?' Anime Announces January 7 Debut
content: The anime will debut in the "Super Animeism Turbo" programming block on MBS , TBS , and 26 affiliated channels, and it will run on Thursdays at 00:26 (effectively, Fridays at 12:26 a.m.) The staff had previously announced that the anime would air in 2026.

title: Bless TV Anime Casts Kōki Uchiyama
content: The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed in a character promotional video on Thursday that Kōki Uchiyama voices Akiharu Nakano in the series.
author: ANN

title: Kei Urana's Gachiakuta Manga Resumes on November 11
content: Manga creator Kei Urana revealed on X (formerly Twitter ) on Thursday that the Gachiakuta manga will return from hiatus on November 11. Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine commented on September 8 on the ongoing hiatus of the manga. Kodansha stated then it would announce the manga's return once it was decided.
author: ANN

title: Firefly Wedding TV Anime Casts Kanon Amane
content: The X (formerly Twitter ) account for the television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding manga revealed a new cast member on Thursday. Kanon Amane will voice Yukari, a courtesan at the "Isekichi" brothel. The anime stars Lynn as Satoko Kirigaya and Kōki Uchiyama as Shinpei Gotō.

title: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World (Iseleve) Season 2 First Trailer, New Cast, January 2027 Release Revealed
content: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in the Real World, Too ( Iseleve ) Season 2 revealed the first trailer and a January 2027 release date. The sequel was announced back in March during AnimeJapan.
